title: Fee Computation Note — The Equipment & Vehicle Loans Deferral Fee
content:
**Computation.** The deferral fee on an Equipment & Vehicle Loans loan is the product's deferral fee for each installment deferred, rounded to cents.

## Inputs and their records

| Input | Record it is read from |
|---|---|
| The product's deferral fee | the product's deferral terms table |
| Installments deferred | one installment per deferral granted |

The fee is booked on the grant date; on a product that offers no deferral no deferral is granted and no fee arises.

## Worked examples (hypothetical inputs)

| Product | Product's deferral fee (from its deferral terms) | Installments deferred | Deferral fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| Truck & Trailer Loan | 75.00 | one | 75.00 |
| Used Equipment Loan | 150.00 | one | 150.00 |
| Grain Storage & Handling Loan | 250.00 | one | 250.00 |
| EquipDirect Dealer Contract | no deferral offered | — | — |
